description: Assign Oilcan 1 to channel 1. Set note masks to MIDI 36, 37 and 38 to select timbres 1, 2 and 3. Set velocity to 48 and enter the eight listed trigs in each bar. Play the four-bar loop at 90 BPM to hear the three percussion sounds in sequence.
synchronization: Observed framebuffer/grid sampled against host monotonic recording time; not sample-exact or physical-norns calibration.
title: Three sounds, one pocket
